page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on KVM virtualization and powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at a base clock of 2.7 GHz. The instance supplies 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory configuration includes 64.0 GB of RAM, adhering to a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware instruction capabilities include AVX-512 extensions such as AVX512_VNNI and AVX512_BF16, alongside AES, VAES, and SHA cryptographic accelerators. The instance does not feature local disk storage or hardware GPUs, relying on remote network-attached block storage for persistence.

Benchmark evaluation reveals robust single-core performance, ranking in the top tier for Geekbench single-core testing with a score of 2006.0 and stress-ng single-core execution at 3073.98. In parallel multi-threaded tests, including PassMark CPU and stress-ng multi-core, performance tracks solidly in the mid-range tier. Memory subsystem testing demonstrates strong cached read speeds of 1216.93 GB/sec for small blocks, whereas large uncached read operations decline to 39.07 GB/sec. Baseline network connectivity provides 7 Gbps throughput, sustaining steady network and web-serving performance under sustained load.

The absence of local disks necessitates off-instance block storage solutions, trading raw local IOPS for persistent storage flexibility and reliability. Compute resource density balances cost efficiency against high single-thread capability, making this configuration practical for standard enterprise infrastructure. The system is well configured for web application serving, mid-sized relational and in-memory databases such as Redis, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and containerized backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.4xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor, delivering 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 64.0 GB of memory. Operating on KVM hypervisor architecture, it incorporates AVX-512 vector execution units and advanced cryptographic instruction support. The server provisions no local disks and includes no discrete GPU hardware, routing storage traffic externally while maintaining a 7 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Empirical benchmark data demonstrates high single-core compute performance alongside mid-tier multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics. With its standard 1:4 core-to-memory distribution, ecs.g8a.4xlarge functions effectively for backend application tiers, static web delivery, continuous integration builds, and in-memory caching systems.
